svg.title: MedSafe Dual-Source RAG — complete workflow flowchart
svg.desc: End-to-end flowchart showing how a clinician request flows through the dual-source RAG pipeline to produce a structured medication safety alert

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who is the end user of MedSafe and what do they input?')
sendPrompt('What inputs does the Safety Checker UI collect from the clinician?')
g.text: Drug name · Patient ID · Dose · Indication

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens when no patient is selected?')
sendPrompt('What HTTP request does the frontend send to the backend?')
sendPrompt('What does the safety_checker.py orchestrator do?')
g.text: Triggers both RAG sources in parallel

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Source 1 (drug knowledge base) work in the RAG pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does Source 2 (patient records) work in the RAG pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How are the two RAG contexts fused into a single prompt?')
g.text: Drug chunk + patient chunk → single prompt

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the first LLM call to Groq produce?')
sendPrompt('What does the second LLM call extract and why is it needed?')
sendPrompt('How is the final MedicationCheckResponse assembled?')
sendPrompt('How is check history saved in MedSafe?')
sendPrompt('What does the frontend display after the safety check completes?')
sendPrompt('What does a clinician see at the end of a MedSafe safety check?')
